title: Hop-anchored Decision Lighthouse: time-synced hop markers + aggregated explainers for routing observability
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a new observability artifact and ingestion flow — the 'Hop-anchored Decision Lighthouse' — that produces a time-synchronized, hop-indexed decision transcript for each routed request. Each transcript should contain lightweight hop markers (anchor entries) and optional sampled artifacts (traces, policy rationale, short model variant diffs). The goal is to make per-request routing decisions debuggable across region/tier/fallback variants while keeping telemetry bandwidth under SLO and storage budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Lighthouse event format defined: stable schema with hop_index, timestamp, decision_kind (region|tier|fallback), decision_reason_id, explainability_score, model_variant_hint, and artifact_refs
Runtime emits anchor-only lighthouse messages for >95% of routed requests with <250B additional payload per request
Sampling path implemented to attach expanded artifacts (policy ACLs, small model diffs, KV cache snapshots) to ~1% of requests configurable per-project and per-tenant
Ingestion pipeline accepts lighthouse events and shows a per-request time-synced timeline in Console debug view with hop markers and ability to expand sampled artifacts
Backfill tool can convert existing routing logs into lighthouse anchors for a configurable time window
Unit and integration tests for emission logic, sampler controls, and console rendering are merged into main
notes: Motivation: current routing logs are too verbose when fully instrumented and too sparse when only top-level decisions are recorded. We need a middle ground: tiny, deterministic anchors for every hop plus an attachable artifact set for deep dives.

Key design decisions so far: 1) anchor-first approach (always-emit tiny markers), 2) artifact storage decoupled from anchors (S3 + index), 3) tenant-level sampling controls exposed via Console and API, 4) introduce an explainability_score (0-1) computed at policy-evaluation time to help surface hops with high-impact rationale.

Storage/Cost targets: anchors should keep avg extra egress < 0.5% and retention-tiered storage for artifacts (hot 7 days, cold 90 days). We will prototype with gzip compression and TLV packing for anchors.
Compatibility: format must be backward compatible with existing route-provenance processors; include a schema_version header and a converter for older logs.
